checklist.why: Purpose line present; does not say "for a figure you tap, use Row".
No when-not; the "never acts" rule is broken in use and no alternative is named.
Label, value, meta named; the preview shows meta and the em-dash empty.
columns 1 and 3 are documented but no atlas screen shows them; only 2 columns appears (piglet-processing pen sheet).
Static; default and empty (em dash / absent group) stated and rendered.
In use the piglet pen sheet puts > buttons inside facts: 26-65px wide x 44px tall (piglet-processing.sheet-todo, pen-log).
Value formatting stated; no long-value example, and dd uses overflow-wrap:anywhere (an ear tag can break mid-ID).
dl/dt/dd semantics are used but not stated.
Raw 18px/20px gaps, 16px padding and 11/14/10px type in bundle.css.
No classification line, no related links (Panel, TaskMetrics).
Preview renders at 375 with no overflow.

variants.name: two-column (default)
findings: In use it carries > buttons the component forbids, narrower than 48px.

variants.name: three-column
findings: No atlas screen shows it (farrowing litter code calls columns:3, but no screen renders it).

findings.text: Judged in use, the piglet pen sheet (Boars · gilts >, Litter weight >, Tagged 0 of 12 >, Breeders kept >) makes facts tappable through valueHtml; each target is a 26-65 x 44px button, not the cell, and the README says facts never act.
findings.fix: Decide one way: add a "tappable fact" option where the whole cell is one 48px-plus button with the > trail, or move those four figures to Rows. Then forbid buttons in valueHtml.

findings.text: Unused variants: columns 1 and 3 have no screen.
findings.fix: Keep only 2 columns until a screen needs 3; delete the 1-column mode or mark both "no screen yet".

findings.text: Raw spacing and type values in bundle.css.
findings.fix: Use space-panel for padding, a gap token pair, and type tokens for label, value and meta.

findings.text: overflow-wrap:anywhere can split an ear tag or batch code across lines.
findings.fix: Set the mono ID span to white-space:nowrap and add a long-value example to the preview.

findings.text: Stale copy in ux/system/sentri-components.js (no data-ds, no strs).

proposals.name: Facts: tappable
proposals.why: The piglet pen sheet needs figures that open their edit sheet; today they are hand-built buttons inside a read-only grid.
